accent.purpose: Water data (gauge fill, chart line) and the focus ring — never chrome.

brand.purpose: Dashboard header and control-panel header bar only.

on.purpose: Device running; darkened from #157f3c for 4.5:1 on on-soft.

warn.purpose: Warnings and the light device tone.

unknown.purpose: Stale or missing telemetry; dashed outline, never a fill.

video-black.purpose: Camera tile surface and video scrims only.

display.purpose: The gate name on a dashboard.

body.purpose: Readings and copy; every number is tabular-nums.

shadows.name: map-popup
shadows.purpose: The one resting shadow: the Leaflet popup, the only static surface that floats.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrances; the only curve for appearing motion.

motion.name: ease-in-out
motion.purpose: On-screen movement, if any is ever added.

motion.name: dur-fast

motion.name: dur-base

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Near-black ink; the one primary action per screen.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-fg, #142029); color: #ffffff; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgb(20 32 41 / 0.85); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3860b0); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White surface with a control border for every non-primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-fg, #142029); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; border: 1px solid var(--color-control, #c9cec6); cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-surface-2, #eceee9); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3860b0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: White field with a control border; focus is the global accent ring.
components.css: .ds-input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); color: var(--color-fg, #142029); font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--color-control, #c9cec6); transition: background 180ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--color-muted, #55606a); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3860b0); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: State Pill (on)
components.description: Dot + word in the state colour; colour never carries the meaning alone.
components.css: .ds-pill-on { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; white-space: nowrap; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-on-soft, #e3f3e8); color: var(--color-on, #136b35); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-on, #136b35); }

components.name: Device Segment (on)
components.description: The filled half of the [ ปิด | เปิด ] switch; carries aria-pressed and the check icon.
components.css: .ds-segment-on { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; min-width: 80px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: var(--color-on, #136b35); color: #ffffff; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms; } .ds-segment-on:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-segment-on:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent, #3860b0); outline-offset: -2px; }

components.name: Feature Tile
components.description: The dashboard content panel: flat white, 1px edge, 16px radius — no shadow.
components.html: ระดับน้ำ
components.css: .ds-tile { min-width: 0; background: var(--color-surface, #ffffff); border: 1px solid var(--color-border, #e1e4df); border-radius: 16px; padding: 20px; } .ds-tile-title { margin: 0 0 16px; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--color-fg, #142029); }

narrative.overview: Calm, light, legible in sunlight, trustworthy like a well-made government utility tool. Not a sci-fi console, not a SaaS template. Flat panels with 1px edges; nothing floats except the map popup and the modal. Colour is rationed: chrome carries ink and navy only; state colours are the loudest thing on screen. Motion is a crisp utility: short fades and colour transitions, one entrance per arrival, nothing over 260 ms.
keyCharacteristics: Flat panels with 1px edges; nothing floats except the map popup and the modal.
Colour is rationed: chrome carries ink and navy only; state colours are the loudest thing on screen.
Every number is tabular; every state is a word plus a dot, never colour alone.
Motion is a crisp utility: short fades and colour transitions, one entrance per arrival, nothing over 260 ms.

rules.name: The Colour-Never-Alone Rule
rules.body: Every state is a word plus a dot plus an icon; colour may never carry the meaning by itself.

rules.name: The Accent-Rationing Rule
rules.body: Accent is water data and the focus ring — chrome never wears it.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number renders font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums. No monospace font anywhere.

rules.name: The Flat-Panel Rule
rules.body: Cards and panels never carry a shadow — the 1px border is the whole edge. If a surface does not float above the page, it gets no shadow.

dos: Do keep every state as word + dot + icon; colour never works alone.
Do keep a stale reading visually muted AND worded (UNKNOWN pill, muted readings) — stale must never look live.
Do use the motion tokens (--dur-fast/--dur-base/--dur-slow, --ease-out) for every transition; entrances are rare-tier one-shots only (route change, login, overlay appears).
Do reserve shadows for the map popup and the modal.
donts: Don't put a shadow on a card, panel or tile (The Flat-Panel Rule).
Don't animate per-telemetry-tick updates — colour transitions only, never keyframes.
Don't wear accent on chrome — brand navy and ink are the only chrome colours.
Don't let any motion run longer than 260 ms, and always honour prefers-reduced-motion (transform entrances fall back to a short fade; spinners keep spinning).
